name: AAAS 2138
title: Islam on Stage
description: (Also offered as DRAM 2138, HRTS 2138.) The role of theatre and representation in the lives of Muslims, particularly in Asian diasporas. Examines performance by Muslim artists, comedians, and others. Students critique and question assumptions about how Islam and those who practice it are represented socially, politically, and theatrically.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
